My ranking only selects the highest-ranked school among those obtainable.

Because of that, the best strategy is to list my true preferences so I receive the most-preferred school available to me. My true preference is y > z > x > w. I also note my priorities: I have top priority (1) at y and w and second (2) at x and z. Most other applicants favor y > x > w > z, so y is competitive, but my top priority at y makes it likely to be in my obtainable set. Regardless of which subset of schools is obtainable, ranking sincerely ensures I get the best available option within that subset. Therefore I should submit my true preference ordering.
